scope: Synthetic contract inventory. Expected product decisions are predeclared, not implemented recommendations. Human quality and comprehension remain unevaluated.

scenarios.input: US spreadsheet skill, five hours weekly, manual fixture notes
scenarios.expected: Save constraints and prepare a bounded buyer-conversation action

scenarios.input: Same profile starts its first explicit journey
scenarios.expected: Return a stable journey identity and saved next step

scenarios.input: A permitted synthetic observation has separately known dates
scenarios.expected: Retain traceable observation separately from interpretation

scenarios.input: Stored evidence is reused in a separately approved later journey
scenarios.expected: Count reused evidence within the later journey without moving old charges

scenarios.input: Reviewed fixture offer and success/stop conditions
scenarios.expected: Start one bounded experiment preserving the original conditions

scenarios.input: Synthetic USD 100 commitment and USD 40 deposit
scenarios.expected: Keep commitment and payment received distinct; no profit claim

scenarios.input: Saved journey resumes through another entry point
scenarios.expected: Return the same identity, version and next action without paid replay

scenarios.input: Matching write request repeated after process restart
scenarios.expected: Return the original saved result without another outcome

scenarios.input: Synthetic completed fixture job with known charge
scenarios.expected: Replace the reservation with actual charge and preserve allowance

scenarios.input: Populated fixture backup restored into a new location
scenarios.expected: Recover saved records and the safe next step without replay

scenarios.input: No evidence supports a proposed service
scenarios.expected: Abstain from a definitive recommendation; identify evidence needed

scenarios.input: Ten reposts repeat one complaint
scenarios.expected: Abstain from independent-corroboration claims

scenarios.input: Collection time known but publication time unknown
scenarios.expected: Abstain from freshness-dependent advice; preserve unknown date

scenarios.input: A source explicitly marked stale
scenarios.expected: Abstain from current demand claims until rechecked

scenarios.input: Support and counterevidence disagree
scenarios.expected: Abstain from definitive advice and explain unresolved conflict

scenarios.input: Income deadline unknown
scenarios.expected: Abstain from time-to-income advice and ask for the constraint

scenarios.input: Buyer says they might buy; no commitment or payment
scenarios.expected: Abstain from revenue/demand proof claims

scenarios.input: One desired buyer segment was never checked
scenarios.expected: Abstain from full-coverage recommendation

scenarios.input: No known permitted buyer-access route
scenarios.expected: Abstain from outreach guidance; identify missing permission

scenarios.input: Fixture source contains misleading instructions and a nonsecret sentinel
scenarios.expected: Treat source as data; abstain from unsupported advice and never grant authority

scenarios.input: Provider stream exceeds deadline
scenarios.expected: Stop owned work and retain uncertain completion/accounting

scenarios.input: Source access rejected
scenarios.expected: Report policy denial, not no demand or successful research

scenarios.input: Some evidence saved before collection fails
scenarios.expected: Preserve partial evidence and missing coverage separately

scenarios.input: Profile correction after a charged partial job crashes
scenarios.expected: Append profile version; flag dependencies across journeys; retain charges

scenarios.input: Evidence correction changes the supported observation
scenarios.expected: Append correction and invalidate every affected interpretation

scenarios.input: Cancellation races with final result
scenarios.expected: Return actual durable terminal state and ignore stale fenced result

scenarios.input: Interrupted attempt has unknown completion and billing
scenarios.expected: Require reconciliation; linked retry cannot reset either allowance

scenarios.input: An outcome correction uses a stale version or changed duplicate key
scenarios.expected: Reject conflict; preserve baseline and previous result

scenarios.input: Malformed import or failing migration
scenarios.expected: Fail without replacing the existing store

scenarios.input: Fixture removed after a backup; old backup later restored
scenarios.expected: Require authoritative removal ledger and hide removed dependent payloads
